evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies Tor onion listening and connection binding behavior in src/init.cpp.
rationale: Prevents Tor peers from misclassifying and inadvertently inheriting IP-based whitelist permissions. As noted in the description, when automatic onion service creation runs without a dedicated onion bind, 'Tor peers arriving through shared or wildcard binds may be classified by IP and inherit address-based whitelist permissions'.
